shortDescription: One brutal set of 20 breathing squats with your 10-rep max, plus 5lb every workout - the classic 6-week "squats and milk" mass program.
descriptionHtml: One brutal set of 20 breathing squats with your 10-rep max, plus 5lb every workout - the classic 6-week "squats and milk" mass program.
author: Randall J. Strossen

exercises.notes:
**Breathing squat** - your 10-rep max for 20 reps, one set. Do NOT rack the bar until rep 20.
- Reps 1-10: normal pace
- Reps 11-20: stand with the bar on your back, take **at least 3 big deep breaths** before each rep. By rep 15 it may be 5-10 breaths
- No belt - it limits breathing
- Go straight to pullovers after the set
Light stretch while you're still breathing hard after the squat. Deep breath in, lower the weight far behind your head, exhale on the way up. Keep it light - 15-20lb. A Rader chest pull works too.
